title: An Empirical Study on Zero-Data Bootstrapping for Conversational Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2504.15476v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conversational Recommender Systems (CRS) typically require domain-specific dialogue data, which is costly, scarce, and often unavailable in new domains. We conduct a systematic empirical study of zero-data CRS bootstrapping: generating synthetic conversational supervision from non-conversational signals---item reviews, metadata, and user-item interactions---without any in-domain dialogue corpus. We compare two information-theoretic selection strategies, Jensen-Shannon diversity and Fisher information, across domain signals, model architectures, datasets, and fine-tuning paradigms. Our results show that domain-grounded synthetic data consistently outperforms zero-shot prompting and naive synthetic baselines; active selection improves data efficiency over random sampling; metadata and collaborative filtering signals each improve selection quality; and, in low-resource settings, synthetic data can outperform scarce real dialogues while

translated_title: 面向对话推荐系统的零数据自举实证研究
translated_abstract: 对话推荐系统（CRS）通常需要特定领域的对话数据，而这些数据成本高昂、稀缺，且在新领域中往往无法获得。我们对零数据CRS自举进行了系统的实证研究：从非对话信号——物品评论、元数据和用户-物品交互——中生成合成的对话监督数据，而无需任何领域内对话语料库。我们在不同领域信号、模型架构、数据集和微调范式下比较了两种信息论选择策略：Jensen-Shannon多样性和Fisher信息。结果表明：基于领域信息的合成数据始终优于零样本提示和朴素的合成数据基线；主动选择策略比随机采样具有更高的数据效率；元数据和协同过滤信号均能提升选择质量；此外，在低资源场景下，合成数据可以超越稀缺的真实对话数据，同时……
tldr: 该研究系统性地验证了从物品评论、元数据和用户-物品交互等非对话信号生成合成对话数据以实现对话推荐系统零数据自举的可行性，并发现基于信息论的主动选择策略可提升数据效率，在低资源场景下合成数据甚至优于稀缺的真实对话数据。
